assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.
images: a person sitting up in bed in a dark bedroom at night, moonlight through the window, a glowing clock showing 3:00
a thin veil of shimmering light hanging in a dark room like a curtain between worlds, soft glow
a quiet window at night with the moon and stars, a faint golden doorway of light in the sky
a person with closed eyes in bed bathed in soft golden light, peaceful, stars around

animate.motion: moonlight shifts slowly across the room, the curtain moves gently, the glowing clock flickers

voices.name: l01
voices.text: 아무 이유 없이 매번 이 시간이라면, <#0.2#> 이건 그냥 넘길 일이 아니에요.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: 영적인 전통에서는 새벽 3시를, <#0.2#> 영혼의 문이 가장 얇아지는 시간이라고 불러요.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: 이때 깨는 사람은, <#0.2#> 무언가를 알아차릴 준비가 된 사람이래요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 다음에 깨면, 휴대폰 말고 눈을 감고 이렇게 물어보세요. <#0.4#> 나는 지금, 무엇을 알아야 하지?

voices.name: l05
voices.text: 물론 잠 문제가 계속된다면, <#0.2#> 병원 진료도 꼭 받아 보세요.
